questions.q: Pointing to a man, Suresh said, "His only brother is the father of my daughter." How is the man related to Suresh?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Brother-in-law. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next? CDE, GHI, KLM, OPQ, …
questions.why: Each group starts 4 letters after the last one, with the same pattern inside: STU. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 80 people, 40 like Konkani, 37 like Marathi and 19 like neither. How many like only Konkani?
questions.why: Both = 40 + 37 − (80 − 19) = 16; only Konkani = 40 − 16 = 24. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word APPLE be arranged?
questions.why: 5 letters with repeats: 5! ÷ 2! = 60. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A train 130 m long at 45 km/h crosses a bridge in 30 seconds. How long is the bridge?
The present ages of Asha and Anil are in the ratio 6 : 5. After 4 years the ratio will be 20 : 17. What is Anil's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 6k and 5k: (6k + 4)/(5k + 4) = 20/17 gives k = 6, so Anil is 30. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If 2 September 2022 was a Friday, what day of the week was 23 September 2022?
questions.why: 21 days later; 21 mod 7 = 0, so count 0 days on from Friday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Should competitive examinations for professional courses be fully online? I. Yes, less printing and transport, faster results. II. No, it disadvantages rural and low-income students without reliable internet.
questions.why: Both give real, relevant consequences. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
